title: Identity law for restricted single transitions
statement: Under the original coefficient identity law, the explicit restricted transitions satisfy the canonical identity equation, transported by the concrete restricted diagram map_id. No coefficient composition law is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09Z1 proof, restriction to an affine etale object; Tag 0EZM coefficient complexes; Tag 03CB canonical inverse-image composition comparisons

proof.text: Expand the raw restricted coefficient. Use D.map_id on the original arrow and the supplied HEq coefficient identity. The induced pullback map is the identity by pullback.hom_ext and the projection equations. Congruence of upperStarComp along equal diagonals followed by upperStarComp_id_left and upperStarComp_id_right cancels the two inverse-image comparisons. This proves the heterogeneous restricted coefficient unit identity, without any coefficient composition assumption.

Apply the single-complex unit lifting theorem to the restricted coefficient unit identity just proved. That theorem evaluates the degree-zero component and uses the zero target in every other degree. The main proof supplies the coefficient identity by explicit inverse-image coherence, not as an extra hypothesis.

theorem restrictedAffineSingleTransition_identity_law {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (U : S.Etale) :
    let D' := restrictedAffineDiagram D U
    let K := restrictedAffineK D F U
    let ψ := fun {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : j ⟶ i) ↦ restrictedAffineSingleTransition D F φ U f
    ( ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (D'.map_id i)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.obj i))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i))
